name: deck-intellisense
description: Class and token completion, hover docs, and typo detection for the Deck CSS framework.

commands.title: Deck: Show loaded API version and counts

deck.enable.description: Master switch. Turn off to disable completion, hover and diagnostics without uninstalling.

deck.languages.markdownDescription: Extra language IDs to treat as markup, beyond the built-in list. Use this for a templating language the extension does not know, e.g. `["liquid", "njk"]`.

deck.completion.classes.description: Suggest Deck class names inside class and className attributes.

deck.completion.tokens.description: Suggest Deck custom properties inside var( ), with a colour swatch where the token is a colour.

deck.completion.icons.description: Suggest icon symbol names after deck-icons.svg#.

deck.diagnostics.enable.description: Report removed, internal and misspelt Deck classes as you type.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Never report a class just because Deck does not define it.
Report only classes that look like a Deck class gone wrong — an off-the-scale number such as `stack-5`, or a one-character slip such as `btn-primery`. Your own app classes are left alone.
Report every class Deck does not define. Only sensible in a project that uses Deck classes exclusively, and noisy everywhere else.
deck.diagnostics.unknownClasses.description: How aggressively to report classes Deck does not define.

deck.diagnostics.internalClasses.description: Warn when markup uses a class that is internal to Deck and may change in a patch release.

deck.diagnostics.stateClasses.description: Hint when markup hand-writes an is-* state class that Deck's JavaScript is supposed to apply.

deck.sourceRoot.markdownDescription: Path to Deck's `src/` folder, for go-to-definition on a class. Leave empty to search `node_modules/@echodial/deck/src` and `vendor/echodial/deck/src` in each workspace folder.
